author: fester
body: A unit-type constructor (e.g. the base ctor a `unit family` member calls, like AbsorbedDose in `Gray n = AbsorbedDose (n * 1000000)`) has no function def -- it is identity, erased at codegen the way x86 erases it. It is neither a builtin nor a variant ctor, and it never appears in `m.defs`, so its arity lookup is -1. The frontend rejects genuinely unresolved names before IR, so a fall-through name absent from the arity map is exactly a unit ctor: emit its single argument. Without this the plug emitted `call $AbsorbedDose` to a func that does not exist and wat2wasm refused the module (CurrentPlan gap 9).
